metadata.name: secretsNote
metadata.description: neutral status trigger, bumped on every lock/unlock/set. reference it to react: =secrets(locked(secretsNote), apiKeys()).

metadata.name: secretsGen
metadata.description: key-set version counter, bumped on every unlock/lock/setKey/del. apiKey reads secrets INTERNALLY (a native verb, no formula-dep edge), so a key change wouldn't otherwise re-fire client cels. Reference it inside the apiKey call — =makeclient("claude", apiKey("anthropic", secretsGen)) — to wire the dep so a key add/del re-arms the client (error↔ready) through runCycle, no manual re-fire. It is a plain top-level cel (NOT in the sealed secrets segment), so referencing it never breaches the seal.

metadata.name: vault.newName
metadata.description: name buffer for the secrets panel's add-a-key row (names aren't secret). cleared after a key is stored.

metadata.name: locked
metadata.description: (trigger?) - the lock state as a BOOLEAN (true=locked). =locked(secretsNote) to track it reactively.

metadata.name: identity
metadata.description: (trigger?) - YOUR identity's PUBLIC key as a shareable base64 string once unlocked, or '🔒 unlock to see your identity' when locked. On unlock the vault mints (first time) or loads (subsequently, from the persistent keystore) ONE non-extractable Ed25519 identity keypair via crypto.identity; the PRIVATE key stays in the keystore and never becomes a cel value — only this public half surfaces. Pass the unlock trigger (=identity(secretsGen)) so it re-renders on unlock/lock through inputMap; share this string, your private key never leaves the keystore.

metadata.name: editKey
metadata.description: (lockCell, name) - per-key edit + delete in one cell. Pass the lock cell (=locked(secretsNote)) first so this cell reacts to lock/unlock. Locked → cannot edit; unlocked → a secret box to set/update + a ✕ delete. =editKey(A1, "anthropic").

metadata.name: vaultKeys
metadata.description: (trigger?) - GENESIS: one ROW per stored key in a keys worksheet — col A = the live handle (🔑 name, referenceable: =claude(chat!A1, keys!A1)), col B = a ✕ delete button. Pass secretsNote so it regenerates as keys change.

metadata.name: unlockVault
metadata.description: () - a password input that unlocks the vault (creates it on first use). the password never touches a cel or formula. status: =secretsNote.

metadata.name: setKey
metadata.description: (name [, trigger]) - a password box that stores a secret under name. Pass secretsNote as the trigger so the box appears once unlocked: =setKey("anthropic", secretsNote). The secret never touches a cel or formula source.

metadata.name: apiKey
metadata.description: (name [, trigger]) - a resolver HANDLE for a stored secret, not the secret. pass to api fns: =claude(chat!A1, apiKey("anthropic")). saves/seeds/ranges only ever carry the name. Optional 2nd arg is a REACTIVITY trigger (ignored by the resolver): pass secretsGen so the cel re-fires when a key is added/removed — =makeclient("claude", apiKey("anthropic", secretsGen)).

metadata.name: apiKeys
metadata.description: () - the stored key NAMES (never values), one per line.

metadata.name: lockVault
metadata.description: () - a 🔒 lock button; locks the vault ON CLICK (forgets keys; sealed secrets stay at rest).

metadata.name: exportVault
metadata.description: () - a button that downloads the sealed archive of your secrets (safe to move between machines).

metadata.name: importVault
metadata.description: () - a file input that loads a sealed archive, then =unlockVault() opens it.

metadata.name: secrets
metadata.description: (lock, names?) - the Secrets panel, authored as a dom() formula (a showcase that interactive UI can be a formula). Compose it reactively from the vault's own readers: =secrets(locked(secretsNote), apiKeys()). Locked → status + an unlock password box. Unlocked → a lock button + a key chip (✎ edit / ✕ delete) per stored key + an add-a-secret row (name → vault.newName, secret → vault.setNamed). Wires the SAME vault.* handlers via on(); no new handlers, no secrets of its own.

metadata.name: domClients
metadata.description: (claude, grok) - a read-only Clients panel. Pass the two client cells (clients.claude / clients.grok) so it re-fires when they (re)mint; each shows 🟢 ready (a captured client handle) or 🔒 locked (secrets locked). Reads CLIENT handles, never the key. =domClients(clients.claude, clients.grok)

metadata.name: vault.unlock
metadata.description: dispatch handler for unlockVault's input — installs the seal hooks for the password (decrypts sealed secrets, creates them on first use).

metadata.name: vault.set
metadata.description: dispatch handler for setKey's input — stores the secret as a sealed cel.

metadata.name: vault.setNamed
metadata.description: dispatch handler for the panel's add-a-key secret field — reads the name from vault.newName + the secret from the event, stores it as a sealed cel.

metadata.name: vault.lock
metadata.description: dispatch handler for the lock button — forgets the unlocked keys (the sealed secrets stay at rest).

metadata.name: vault.del
metadata.description: dispatch handler for a per-key ✕ delete button (payload = key name) — blanks and drops the key.

metadata.name: vault.export
metadata.description: dispatch handler for exportVault's button — downloads the sealed archive of your secrets.

metadata.name: vault.import
metadata.description: dispatch handler for importVault's file input — hint to load a sealed archive via the host, then =unlockVault().

metadata.name: vault.startEdit
metadata.description: panel ✎: start editing a key — populate the add-key name buffer so the next secret overwrites it
